big_case.notes: Fact-bound criminal venue petition seeking only a summary GVR under Abouammo v. United States, 608 U.S. 597 (2026), on 26 U.S.C. § 7206(2) counts after the Fourth Circuit already denied rehearing en banc without a poll. While constitutional venue and multi-year prison sentences (84 and 48 months) carry real stakes for the two defendants, the Solicitor General waived a response, no amici participated, and the Court denied certiorari without comment or dissent, leaving zero broader doctrinal or public impact.
